purpose: 1A-9 frozen diagnostic fixture for work-engine-organization. requirements.json is reconstructed by hand from the frozen vertical; it is not generated by the crate and is not an authored requirement set of the semantic authority.

job-policy.proposed.json.excerpt: job-policy-excerpt.json (the completionConsumer value only; the file holds local paths and unrelated policy)

reconstruction: problemScope.runId, sliceNumber: episode-authority.json identity (runId, sliceNumber); planLineage: identity.planVersion (r2 renamed planVersion to planLineage); the value mapping is a reading, not a stated rule.

obligations[0].id: selection.json specialists[0].obligationId; resultContract id implementation-review from specialists[0].skill, version 1 per contract 6; scope.digest is NOT established by any frozen file: selection.subject.patchIdentity is used as a stand-in (the only 64-hex subject digest), so no comparison depends on it.

conditions: one per requiredClaims entry. consumerClass: builder for the consumer prefix slice-builder, campaign for slice-campaign. consumptionBoundary, coveredState, proposition, acceptance.unestablishedRoute copied verbatim. acceptor: claim.acceptance.owner.

normative: continuity, integrityRequired true -> verified_artifacts, requiredCapabilities [] copied; mutation none and evidenceCustody execution_evidence_custody are the v1 constants (contract r4 4.3 rows); observerClass independent_execution_evidence is the class of admissibleObservers[review-execution-evidence] (contract r3 section 5 row).

realizationConstraints: provider_family [anthropic] and execution_confinement [guarded_sandbox] from the 'guarded Claude' acceptance phrase (contract r3 section 5 row, an unissued proposal); no concrete identity (rp0-guarded-claude-v1, claude-cli-json-v1, review-execution-evidence) is carried.
requiredAuthorities: one accept_claim entry per acceptor and boundary. Provenance: implied by 5.1 section 3.1 L262 (amendment 5.1-A1 section 8, test 1A-9); the frozen files do not state them.
